`enum PositionProperty`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.property` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [PositionProperty.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/property/PositionProperty.java)

Whether a node is placed inside its parent or on the canvas.

## Learn more

- [Position and size](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/position-and-size/#take-a-node-out-of-its-parents-positions)

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`RELATIVE`](#PositionProperty-value-RELATIVE) | The node is placed from the top-left corner of its parent, and follows its layout and its scroll. |
| [`ABSOLUTE`](#PositionProperty-value-ABSOLUTE) | The node is placed on the canvas, out of the layout, the scroll and the content size of its parent. |

## Value details

<a id="PositionProperty-value-RELATIVE"></a>

### RELATIVE

`RELATIVE` 

The node is placed from the top-left corner of its parent, and follows its layout and its scroll.

<a id="PositionProperty-value-ABSOLUTE"></a>

### ABSOLUTE

`ABSOLUTE`
